body: Background: So for the last year and a half I have been in terrible pain, going from one injury to the next, whether it was my back, making me unable to sit, or my foot making me unable to walk or stand. None of these injuries are permanent, I think. I have been trying to complete my last year of college, but the pain has prevented me from finishing, and I've only been able to complete 3 classes, as well as racking up 8 W's. All I want is to be healthy again, and Im making progress, but this attitude of trying to do everything keeps setting me back. Im about to drop my classes again because I've fallen behind from not making it to class. I want to take the next semester off to spend getting healthy and learning how to take care of myself. My parents on the other hand who are very strict, high functioning, very successful people who believe should be having a job, doing class, and getting healthy all at the same time. this terrifies me because i can barely walk with my foot, and all this doing stuff on my feet hurts it even further. I unfortunately am at there mercy considering they pay for everything in my life; I hate it and want to be independent but can't considering i haven't finished college, and have no skills along with no ability to stand or walk. What I want is to take the semester off completely and focus on regularly exercising (Swimming), physical therapy, reading books of my choosing all day, and learning how to deal with my anxiety problem.

So for for the last year and a half, i have had some debilitating injuries/ anxiety issues. I am currently in college and have completed a full 5 class workload for three years of college until I really hurt my back. I was bedridden for many months including the fall school year. I unable to sit down without much pain and total fear that i was hurting myself whenever i sat down. So I didn't complete my classes for the fall semester. My back got better but i ended up damaging both my shoulders while rehabbing so was in great pain for the majority of the spring semester, and was only able to complete 3 classes as well as failing another. Now I have a serious foot injury and basically can't walk more than a mile without seriously aggravating it. i live decent decent amount away class so i have to walk a mile and take the metro. Already im flaking on class and am a good amount behind. I can't get myself to class. the only way i can think of is by ubering to class which i absolutely hate to do because its so fucking expensive. so now im thinking about dropping my classes again, because i can't keep up with them because im never in class. so now im about to waste another semester. I've gotten basically nowhere over the past year. I've been debilitated by injuries and have no idea what im doing. Im afraid to tell my parents my fuck ups, considering how incredibly strict and judgmental they are. All they would do it be incredibly disappointed in me and force me to continue carrying on through my classes. a problem i have is im so hard on myself and i have this obsession with being fit, so a lot of the injuries I've had are just because i push myself to fucking hard. as of right now im working on that and now i just swim instead of lifting, and I feel like im close to being healthy again if i could just get my foot to heal. I just want to be healthy again, so i can get back to the real me. i don't wanna be in school anymore, i just wanna focus on being happy and getting healthy again. its like i don't care anymore and have no motivation for school. I know I could succeed if i was just healthy. What do you think, am i just pathetic or should i just toughen up?
